subclasses.name: Warrior of Shadow
subclasses.subclass_flavor: Warriors of Shadow practice stealth and subterfuge, harnessing the power of the Shadowfell. They are at home in darkness, able to draw gloom around themselves to hide, leap from shadow to shadow, and take on a wraithlike form.
desc: Warriors of Shadow practice stealth and subterfuge, harnessing the power of the Shadowfell. They are at home in darkness, able to draw gloom around themselves to hide, leap from shadow to shadow, and take on a wraithlike form.

feature_details.Shadow Arts: **Darkness** — spend 1 Focus Point to cast Darkness (no components; you can see in it; move its area up to 60 ft at the start of each of your turns). **Darkvision** — 60 ft, or +60 ft if you already have it. **Shadowy Figments** — know Minor Illusion (Wisdom as spellcasting ability).

feature_details.Shadow Step: While entirely in Dim Light/Darkness, Bonus Action to teleport up to 60 ft to an unoccupied space you can see that's also in Dim Light/Darkness; Advantage on your next melee attack before end of turn.

feature_details.Improved Shadow Step: Spend 1 Focus Point when using Shadow Step to remove the Dim Light/Darkness start/end requirement; can make an Unarmed Strike immediately after teleporting.

feature_details.Cloak of Shadows: As a Magic action while entirely in Dim Light/Darkness, expend 3 Focus Points to shroud yourself for 1 minute (or until Incapacitated or you end your turn in Bright Light): **Invisibility** — Invisible condition. **Partially Incorporeal** — move through occupied spaces as Difficult Terrain (shunted to last unoccupied space if you end turn in one). **Shadow Flurry** — use Flurry of Blows without spending Focus Points.

subclasses.name: Warrior of the Elements
subclasses.subclass_flavor: Warriors of the Elements tap into the power of the Elemental Planes. Harnessing their supernatural focus, these Monks momentarily tame the energy of the Elemental Chaos to empower themselves in and out of battle.
desc: Warriors of the Elements tap into the power of the Elemental Planes. Harnessing their supernatural focus, these Monks momentarily tame the energy of the Elemental Chaos to empower themselves in and out of battle.

feature_details.Elemental Attunement: At the start of your turn, expend 1 Focus Point to imbue yourself for 10 minutes (or until Incapacitated): **Reach** — Unarmed Strike reach +10 ft. **Elemental Strikes** — Unarmed Strike hits can deal Acid/Cold/Fire/Lightning/Thunder instead of normal damage; when you do, target makes a Strength save or is moved up to 10 ft toward/away from you.
feature_details.Manipulate Elements: Know the Elementalism spell (Wisdom as spellcasting ability).

feature_details.Elemental Burst: As a Magic action, expend 2 Focus Points — 20-ft-radius Sphere within 120 ft, one damage type of your choice (Acid/Cold/Fire/Lightning/Thunder). Dexterity save; fail: damage equal to three Martial Arts die rolls; success: half.

feature_details.Stride of the Elements: While Elemental Attunement is active, also gain a Fly Speed and Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

feature_details.Elemental Epitome: While Elemental Attunement is active: **Damage Resistance** — Resistance to one chosen type (Acid/Cold/Fire/Lightning/Thunder), changeable at the start of each turn. **Destructive Stride** — using Step of the Wind grants +20 ft Speed for the turn; a chosen creature takes one Martial Arts die roll of damage (your choice of type) when you enter a space within 5 ft of it (once per creature per turn). **Empowered Strikes** — once per turn, extra damage equal to one Martial Arts die roll (same type as the strike) on an Unarmed Strike hit.

subclasses.name: Warrior of the Open Hand
subclasses.subclass_flavor: Warriors of the Open Hand are masters of unarmed combat. They learn techniques to push and trip their opponents and manipulate their own energy to protect themselves from harm.
desc: Warriors of the Open Hand are masters of unarmed combat. They learn techniques to push and trip their opponents and manipulate their own energy to protect themselves from harm.

feature_details.Open Hand Technique: On a Flurry of Blows hit, impose one: **Addle** — target can't make Opportunity Attacks until start of its next turn. **Push** — Strength save or pushed up to 15 ft away. **Topple** — Dexterity save or Prone.

feature_details.Wholeness of Body: As a Bonus Action, roll your Martial Arts die and regain that many + your Wisdom modifier HP (minimum 1). Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once), regained on a Long Rest.

feature_details.Fleet Step: When you take a Bonus Action other than Step of the Wind, you can also use Step of the Wind immediately after it.

feature_details.Quivering Palm: On an Unarmed Strike hit, expend 4 Focus Points to start imperceptible vibrations lasting a number of days equal to your Monk level (harmless unless ended). End them (an action, or by forgoing one Attack-action attack) while on the same plane as the target — Constitution save; fail: 10d12 Force damage; success: half. Only one creature affected at a time; can end harmlessly with no action.

subclasses.name: Oath of Devotion
subclasses.subclass_flavor: The Oath of Devotion binds Paladins to the ideals of justice and order. These Paladins meet the archetype of the knight in shining armor. They hold themselves to the highest standards of conduct, and some—for better or worse—hold the rest of the world to the same standards. Tenets: Let your word be your promise. Protect the weak and never fear to act. Let your honorable deeds be an example.

feature_details.Sacred Weapon: When you take the Attack action, expend a Channel Divinity use to imbue a Melee weapon you're holding for 10 minutes (or until reused) — add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls with it (minimum +1); on a hit, its damage type can be Radiant instead of normal. feature_details.Smite of Protection: Whenever you cast Divine Smite, you and allies gain Half Cover while in your Aura of Protection until the start of your next turn.

feature_details.Holy Nimbus: As a Bonus Action, imbue your Aura of Protection for 10 minutes (or until dismissed, no action) — **Holy Ward**: Advantage on saves forced by a Fiend or Undead. **Radiant Damage**: enemies starting their turn in the aura take Radiant damage equal to your Charisma modifier + Proficiency Bonus. **Sunlight**: the aura is filled with Bright Light that counts as sunlight. Once per Long Rest; restorable by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action).

subclasses.name: Oath of Glory
subclasses.subclass_flavor: Paladins who take the Oath of Glory believe they and their companions are destined to achieve glory through deeds of heroism. They train diligently and encourage their companions, so they're all ready when destiny calls. Tenets: Endeavor to be known by your deeds. Face hardships with courage. Inspire others to strive for glory.

feature_details.Inspiring Smite: Immediately after casting Divine Smite, expend a Channel Divinity use to distribute Temp HP (total = 2d8 + your Paladin level) among creatures within 30 ft (can include you), split however you like.

feature_details.Peerless Athlete: As a Bonus Action, expend a Channel Divinity use — for 1 hour, Advantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks, and Long/High jump distance +10 ft (costs movement as normal).

feature_details.Glorious Defense: Reaction when you or a creature within 10 ft is hit by an attack roll — grant a bonus to its AC against that attack equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1), possibly causing a miss; if it misses, you can make one weapon attack against the attacker (if in range) as part of this Reaction. Uses equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum once), regained on a Long Rest.

feature_details.Living Legend: As a Bonus Action, gain for 1 minute — **Charismatic**: Advantage on all Charisma checks. **Saving Throw Reroll**: Reaction to reroll a failed save (must use new roll). **Unerring Strike**: once per turn, turn a missed weapon attack roll into a hit. Once per Long Rest; restorable by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action).

subclasses.name: Oath of the Ancients
subclasses.subclass_flavor: The Oath of the Ancients is as old as the first elves. Paladins who swear this oath cherish the light; they love the beautiful and life-giving things of the world more than any principles of honor, courage, and justice. They adorn their armor and clothing with images of growing things—leaves, antlers, or flowers—to reflect their commitment to preserving life and light. Tenets: Kindle the light of hope. Shelter life. Delight in art and laughter.

feature_details.Undying Sentinel: When reduced to 0 HP but not killed outright, drop to 1 HP instead and regain HP equal to 3x your Paladin level; once per Long Rest. Also, you can't be magically aged and stop visibly aging.

feature_details.Elder Champion: As a Bonus Action, imbue your Aura of Protection for 1 minute (or until dismissed, no action) — **Diminish Defiance**: enemies in the aura have Disadvantage on saves against your spells and Channel Divinity options. **Regeneration**: regain 10 HP at the start of each of your turns. **Swift Spells**: cast action-casting-time spells as a Bonus Action instead. subclasses.subclass_flavor: The Oath of Vengeance is a solemn commitment to punish those who have committed grievously evil acts. feature_details.Soul of Vengeance: Immediately after a creature under your Vow of Enmity hits or misses with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to make a melee attack against it if in range.

feature_details.Avenging Angel: As a Bonus Action, gain for 10 minutes (or until dismissed, no action) — **Flight**: spectral wings, Fly Speed 60 ft, can hover. **Frightful Aura**: enemies starting their turn in your Aura of Protection fail a Wisdom save or are Frightened 1 minute (or until damaged); attacks against a Frightened creature this way have Advantage. subclasses.name: Beast Master
subclasses.subclass_flavor: A Beast Master forms a mystical bond with a special animal, drawing on primal magic and a deep connection to the natural world.
desc: A Beast Master forms a mystical bond with a special animal, drawing on primal magic and a deep connection to the natural world.

feature_details.Primal Companion: Summon a primal beast (choose stat block: Beast of the Land, Beast of the Sea, or Beast of the Sky, and the kind of animal appropriate to it) — Friendly to you and allies, obeys your commands, vanishes if you die. **The Beast in Combat**: acts on your turn — moves and uses its Reaction on its own, but only takes the Dodge action unless you use a Bonus Action to command another action from its stat block, or you sacrifice one of your own Attack-action attacks to command its Beast's Strike action. If you're Incapacitated, it acts fully on its own. **Restoring or Replacing**: if it died within the last hour, a Magic action + spell slot touching it revives it in 1 minute at full HP; on a Long Rest, you can summon a different beast (old one vanishes) in an unoccupied space within 5 ft.

feature_details.Exceptional Training: When commanding an action via Bonus Action, you can also command Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or Help as its Bonus Action. Its damage-dealing hits can be Force damage or normal type, your choice.

feature_details.Bestial Fury: Beast's Strike action can be used twice when commanded. First hit each turn on a creature under your Hunter's Mark deals extra Force damage equal to that spell's bonus damage.

feature_details.Share Spells: When you cast a spell targeting only yourself, you can also affect your Primal Companion if it's within 30 ft.

feature_details.Superior Hunter's Defense: Reaction when you take damage — gain Resistance to that damage type (and any other damage of the same type) until the end of the current turn.

feature_details.Wild Magic Surge: Once per turn, immediately after casting a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot, roll 1d20; on a 20, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table (below). A resulting spell effect can't be modified by Metamagic.
feature_details.Tides of Chaos: Give yourself Advantage on one D20 Test before rolling. Then you must cast a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot (which auto-triggers a Wild Magic Surge table roll) or finish a Long Rest before using this again.

feature_details.Bend Luck: Reaction immediately after another visible creature rolls a d20 for a D20 Test — spend 1 Sorcery Point, roll 1d4, apply it as a bonus or penalty (your choice) to that roll.

feature_details.Controlled Chaos: Whenever you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, roll twice and use either result.

feature_details.Tamed Surge:

  - **Wild Magic Surge table** (d100): **01-04** Roll on this table at the start of each turn for 1 minute (ignore this result on later rolls). **05-08** A Friendly creature appears in a random unoccupied space within 60 ft for 1 minute (DM-controlled); 2 an ally within 300 ft regains 2d10 HP; 3 regain your lowest-level expended spell slot; 4 an ally within 300 ft regains their lowest-level expended spell slot; 5 regain all expended Sorcery Points; 6 all of row 17-20's effects happen simultaneously.

subclasses.name: Archfey Patron
subclasses.subclass_flavor: Your pact draws on the power of the Feywild. When you choose this subclass, you might make a deal with an archfey, such as the Prince of Frost; the Queen of Air and Darkness, ruler of the Gloaming Court; Titania of the Summer Court; or an ancient hag. Or you might call on a spectrum of Fey, weaving a web of favors and debts. Whoever they are, your patron is often inscrutable and whimsical.

feature_details.Steps of the Fey: Cast Misty Step without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum once), regained on a Long Rest. Whenever cast, add one option: **Refreshing Step** — you or a creature within 10 ft gains 1d10 Temp HP; **Taunting Step** — creatures within 5 ft of the space you left make a Wisdom save or have Disadvantage on attacks against others until start of your next turn.

feature_details.Beguiling Defenses: Immune to Charmed. feature_details.Bewitching Magic: Immediately after casting an Enchantment or Illusion spell (action + spell slot), cast Misty Step as part of the same action without a spell slot.

feature_details.Thought Shield: Immune to telepathy unless you allow it. Resistance to Psychic damage; a creature dealing Psychic damage to you takes the same amount back.

feature_details.Create Thrall: Cast Summon Aberration without Concentration (capping duration at 1 minute); the summoned Aberration gets Temp HP equal to your Warlock level + Charisma modifier, and its first hit each turn on a creature under your Hex deals extra Psychic damage equal to Hex's bonus damage.

subclasses.name: Abjurer
subclasses.subclass_flavor: Your study of magic is focused on spells that block, banish, or protect—ending harmful effects, banishing evil influences, and protecting the weak. Abjurers are sought when baleful spirits require exorcism, when important locations must be guarded against magical spying, and when portals to other planes of existence must be closed. Adventuring parties value Abjurers for the protection they provide their companions against a variety of hostile magic and other attacks.

feature_details.Abjuration Savant: Add 2 Abjuration spells (level 2 or lower) to your spellbook for free; add one more free Abjuration spell (of an eligible level) each time you gain access to a new spell slot level.
feature_details.Arcane Ward: When casting an Abjuration spell with a slot, create a ward on yourself (lasts until a Long Rest) with HP max = 2x your Wizard level + Intelligence modifier; it absorbs damage you take (apply your Resistances/Vulnerabilities first) until it hits 0 HP, after which you take the remainder. Casting an Abjuration spell with a slot restores 2x the slot’s level to the ward’s HP; alternatively, as a Bonus Action, expend a slot for the same restoration. Can only be created once per Long Rest.

feature_details.Projected Ward: Reaction when a creature within 30 ft you can see takes damage — your Arcane Ward absorbs it instead (same Resistance/Vulnerability and overflow rules).

feature_details.Spell Breaker: Always have Counterspell and Dispel Magic prepared; can cast Dispel Magic as a Bonus Action, adding your Proficiency Bonus to its check. Casting either with a slot that fails to stop the target spell doesn’t expend the slot.

feature_details.Spell Resistance: Advantage on saves against spells; Resistance to spell damage.

subclasses.name: Diviner
subclasses.subclass_flavor: The counsel of a Diviner is sought by those who seek a clearer understanding of the past, present, and future. As a Diviner, you strive to part the veils of space, time, and consciousness. You work to master spells of discernment, remote viewing, supernatural knowledge, and foresight.
desc: The counsel of a Diviner is sought by those who seek a clearer understanding of the past, present, and future. As a Diviner, you strive to part the veils of space, time, and consciousness. You work to master spells of discernment, remote viewing, supernatural knowledge, and foresight.

feature_details.Divination Savant: Add 2 Divination spells (level 2 or lower) to your spellbook for free; add one more free Divination spell (of an eligible level) each time you gain access to a new spell slot level.
feature_details.Portent: On finishing a Long Rest, roll two d20s and record them; before any d20 Test (yours or a creature’s you can see), you can substitute one recorded roll instead (once per turn). Unused rolls are lost on your next Long Rest.

feature_details.Expert Divination: Casting a Divination spell with a level 2+ slot regains a spell slot of lower level than the one spent (max level 5).

feature_details.The Third Eye: As a Bonus Action, choose one until your next Short/Long Rest: **Darkvision** (120 ft); **Greater Comprehension** (read any language); **See Invisibility** (cast it without a slot). Once per Short/Long Rest.

feature_details.Greater Portent: Portent now rolls three d20s instead of two.

subclasses.name: Evoker
subclasses.subclass_flavor: Your studies focus on magic that creates powerful elemental effects such as bitter cold, searing flame, rolling thunder, crackling lightning, and burning acid. Some Evokers find employment in military forces, serving as artillery to blast armies from afar. Others use their power to protect others, while some seek their own gain.

feature_details.Evocation Savant: Add 2 Evocation spells (level 2 or lower) to your spellbook for free; add one more free Evocation spell (of an eligible level) each time you gain access to a new spell slot level.
feature_details.Potent Cantrip: A creature that avoids your damaging cantrip (miss or successful save) still takes half damage, with no other cantrip effect.

feature_details.Sculpt Spells: When casting an Evocation spell affecting other visible creatures, choose a number of them equal to 1 + the spell’s level — they auto-succeed their save and take no damage on a would-be-half-damage success.

feature_details.Empowered Evocation: Add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of an Evocation spell you cast.

feature_details.Overchannel: Casting a damage-dealing spell (slot level 1-5) can deal maximum damage instead of rolling. First use each Long Rest: no cost. Subsequent uses before a Long Rest: take 2d12 Necrotic damage per spell slot level (ignores Resistance/Immunity), increasing by 1d12 per additional use.

subclasses.name: Illusionist
subclasses.subclass_flavor: You specialize in magic that dazzles the senses and tricks the mind, and the illusions you craft make the impossible seem real.
desc: You specialize in magic that dazzles the senses and tricks the mind, and the illusions you craft make the impossible seem real.

feature_details.Illusion Savant: Add 2 Illusion spells (level 2 or lower) to your spellbook for free; add one more free Illusion spell (of an eligible level) each time you gain access to a new spell slot level.
feature_details.Improved Illusions: Cast Illusion spells without Verbal components; Illusion spells with range 10+ ft get +60 ft range. Also know Minor Illusion (doesn’t count against cantrips known, or learn a different cantrip if already known) — cast it as a Bonus Action, and create both a sound and an image with one casting.

feature_details.Phantasmal Creatures: Always have Summon Beast and Summon Fey prepared; casting either can change its school to Illusion (spectral appearance) and be cast without a spell slot (halves the summoned creature’s HP). Once per Long Rest for the no-slot casting.

feature_details.Illusory Self: Reaction when hit by an attack roll — interpose an illusory duplicate, causing an automatic miss (illusion then dissipates). Once per Short/Long Rest; restorable by expending a level 2+ spell slot (no action).

feature_details.Illusory Reality: When casting an Illusion spell with a slot, as a Bonus Action while it’s ongoing, make one inanimate nonmagical object part of the illusion real for 1 minute (can’t deal damage or impose conditions).
